environment.description: Same Ktor container image deployed via AWS Lambda Web Adapter (lambda-adapter) with a Lambda Function URL as the invocation endpoint. The Function URL is configured with AuthType=AWS_IAM. The Lambda resource-based policy does NOT include a principal grant for '*' or any anonymous/unauthenticated principal. The function's execution role has no lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission granted to external accounts. CloudTrail logs confirm that any request lacking a valid SigV4 signature receives HTTP 403 from the Lambda Function URL service layer before the container code executes. No API Gateway or ALB sits in front of the function URL.

config.resource_policy: no statement granting invoke to '*' or 'anonymous'
config.network: no public ALB/API Gateway; function URL is the sole ingress
config.note: unauthenticated HTTP requests receive 403 at the AWS service layer prior to Lambda cold start
